rami (DevEx): quick heads-up -- we keep getting support tickets where the quickstart shows a vague error and the SDK logs only a numeric status. reproducible with minimal steps.

olga (SDK): can you paste one of the payloads from the API?

rami (DevEx): example from logs: POST /v1/respond 401
{"error":"unauthorized","detail":"token missing scope:responses.write","trace_id":"tx-9a8b7c"}
SDK surfaced: Error: 401 (Request failed). No code/hint/trace.

tariq (sample-app): result: quickstart spins a refresh loop for some users. We call tokenRefresh() on any 401 which causes a "refresh storm" when the token actually lacks scope.

olga (SDK): agreed this is bad. proposal: add small stable error surface across SDKs: string `code` (ERR_AUTH / ERR_PERM / ERR_RATE_LIMIT / ERR_VALIDATION / ERR_INTERNAL), int `status`, string `message`, array `hints`, bool `is_retryable`, string `trace_id`. keep it minimal.

jing (PM): +1. also suggest a UX pattern for quickstart: if err.code==ERR_AUTH and hints mention scope, show a non-blocking banner "Token missing scope: responses.write" with a link to the scopes page instead of auto-refresh.

rami (DevEx): also useful to add `is_transient` vs `is_permanent` semantics. E.g., 401 due to expired token -> transient (retryable), 401 due to missing scope -> permanent (not retryable). SDK should derive `is_retryable` from both status and server-provided hint when present.

olga (SDK): implementation note: we'll map basic HTTP classes to code by default, but prefer server-provided `error.code` when present. Suggested mapping: 400->ERR_VALIDATION, 401->ERR_AUTH, 403->ERR_PERM or ERR_QUOTA if body.reason=="quota_exceeded", 429->ERR_RATE_LIMIT (include `retry_after` if present), 5xx->ERR_INTERNAL. SDK will expose typed exceptions (AuthError, RateLimitError, ValidationError) that include the fields above.

tariq (sample-app): I'll change quickstart to call `shouldRetry(err)` util from SDK rather than trying to guess. Add a UI helper that reads `err.hints[0]` and renders a short suggestion.

olga (SDK): about Retry-After: infra sometimes sends 0 or missing header. SDK logic: prefer numeric Retry-After header -> fallback to server `retry_after` field -> fallback to client backoff with jitter. We'll document recommended backoff behavior.

build-bot: CI: sample-app/quickstart tests failing on branch fix/error-surface - 2 failing tests (expected no refresh on permanent 401).

rami (DevEx): tests: please add an e2e that stubs API returning {error: 'unauthorized', detail: 'token missing scope:responses.write'} and asserts SDK does not call tokenRefresh more than once. Also check Console shows trace_id and hint.

jing (PM): I'll file a short RFC with code enums and migration plan. we'll keep legacy parsing as fallback for one release and log a deprecation warning when SDK sees only numeric messages.

olga (SDK): timeline: implement typed errors + shouldRetry utility this sprint, add Node/Python/Go tests. We'll also add a lightweight migration doc in the SDK repo.

tariq (sample-app): PR incoming to stop refresh storms and show "Grant required scope: responses.write" banner. adds unit + e2e.

rami (DevEx): follow-up: surface `code` and `hints` in Console error inspector to make onboarding debugging faster (trace_id is especially helpful).

build-bot: NOTE: migration note added to changelog in draft PR.

jing (PM): thanks everyone. tracking: RFC, SDK PRs, sample-app PR. will monitor support tickets next week. :thumbsup:
